text: はやく　ひきかえさないと　…　なかまを　よぶぜ！

structure.jp: はやく　ひきかえさないと
structure.en: if you don't turn back quick

patterns.name: 〜ないと
patterns.explanation: A 'not' verb plus と means 'if you don't', and what follows is what will happen then. ひきかえさないと = 'if you don't turn back'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes the statement at the listener. よぶぜ = 'I'll call them, you hear!'
